figurative_meaning_en: To deceive or cheat by misleading
similar_in_english: To pull the wool over someone's eyes
To take someone for a ride
example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রতারকরা লোকদের আমড়াগাছি করে সম্পত্তি হাতিয়ে নেয়।
example_sentences_in_english: He deceived me in the business deal.
Scammers mislead people to swindle their property.
note: The idiom draws from the visual similarity between hog plum (amṛḍā) and mango trees in Bengali rural contexts.
